summary: Feed s146_double is degraded: 82% encrypted bytes exceeds IDS 60% tolerance and 7.4% frames exceed 1518B MTU and are dropped by IDS NIC.

findings.root_cause: 82% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) vs IDS tolerance of 60%. Traffic is not being decrypted before the IDS, so payload is opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot inspect payloads for signatures/behavioral detection; 82% of traffic is blind, severely reducing detection coverage for encrypted attacks/C2.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs cleartext payload but cannot decrypt itself; decrypt upstream (e.g., SSL visibility appliance/packet broker decryption) or feed decrypted copy, respecting privacy/policy, to restore inspection.

findings.root_cause: 242 of 3254 frames (7.4%) exceed IDS port MTU of 1518 bytes, largest 8058 bytes. Likely jumbo frames or tunnel/SPAN overhead not normalized; IDS NIC drops oversize frames.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS silently drops 7.4% of frames due to MTU exceedance, creating coverage holes. Because this IDS needs full payload, slicing/trimming is not viable and attacks in large frames are missed.

recommended_fix.why: Tool requires full payload so cannot use slicing to fit MTU. Normalize MTU end-to-end: increase IDS NIC MTU to support jumbos (e.g., 9000+) or configure packet broker to fragment/normalize oversize frames to 1518B before delivery.
